title: Agent Loop Detection
signature: class LoopGuard: __init__(self, n_repeat=3, max_cycle=3), check(self, name, arguments) -> None | dict
hints: Turn each call into one comparable string: the name plus json.dumps(arguments, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).
Check the call before it is recorded as executed: append it to your history, then look at the tail of the history.
A cycle of length L means history[-2L:-L] == history[-L:]. Try L = 2, 3, ... and skip blocks where every call is identical; that is the repeat rule's job.
